caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure placed on a rectangular base. The figure is dressed in a long, dark blue robe that drapes to the ground and partially covers his feet, with white shoes peeking out from underneath. The man’s right hand is tucked into the front of his robe at chest height, while his left hand is holding a rolled document at his side. The statue features detailed facial features and hair, with pale skin tones used for the face and hands. The base of the statue is greenish-brown and stands out against the otherwise blank, light beige background. The composition centers the figure vertically and horizontally within the frame.
title: Garden Figure - George Washington
